_how_to_edit: This is the ONE place for what the audit-trail page shows and how it's worded. To hide a data point, delete its entry or set "show": false. To reorder, move the entry up or down in its list. To rename, change "label". "field" must match a field name in trip_result.schema.json; dots mean a field inside another one (e.g. travel_to_branch.minutes). "format" tells the page how to display the value: text, currency (value is in CENTS, the page divides by 100), minutes, datetime, date, number, list, mileage, yes_no, status, priority, tags, cancellation, source, environment. Words in {curly_braces} are filled in by the page.
